subject.title: fix(ui): turn large pasted text into compact composer attachments

question: Should Control UI automatically convert every plain-text paste over 1000 characters into an attachment by default?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish a reversible, lossless behavior, but they cannot determine whether established native paste behavior should change for all existing users.

options.title: Accept automatic conversion
options.body: Keep the 1000-character threshold with the visible restore action and existing attachment transport.

options.title: Require explicit conversion
options.body: Preserve native paste behavior and expose attach-as-text through a user-triggered action.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the PR until maintainers agree on a different trigger policy.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic conversion
recommendation.body: Keep the 1000-character threshold with the visible restore action and existing attachment transport.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the nearest prior composer paste policy and are the strongest history-backed owner for this Control UI interaction decision.
